**LAR-COMPACT-SYSARCH-ENVELOPE** — examined `f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228`. The following is a feasible **envelope/packing proposal**, subject to native checks and engineering qualification.

**Tracker/solenoid clearance**

DES026 requires retaining the **1640 mm assembly reservation plus 60 mm external interface**. Therefore use **1700 mm LAr warm bore**, preserving the unresolved 81.344 mm engineering margin outside the computed 1558.656 mm solenoid vessel. A full endcap overlapping the solenoid annulus must start beyond |z|3950 mm.

**Compact barrel ledger**

| Boundary/allocation | Proposed value |
|---|---:|
| Warm bore | 1700 mm |
| Front warm wall / vacuum / cold wall / bath | 10 / 49 / 3.8 / 10 mm |
| Sampling front | 1772.8 mm |
| Preserved outer/inner sampling ratio | 1.1866255523 |
| Sampling back | 2103.649779 mm |
| Rear bath | 210 mm |
| Rear cold wall / vacuum / warm wall | 30 / 49 / 2.7 mm |
| Warm outer radius | **2395.349779 mm** |
| Warm / sampling half-length | 4100 / 3910 mm |

The 210 mm bath accommodates the necessary board repacking without shrinking physical hardware:

- Three banks at sampling-back offsets **15, 60 and 105 mm**.
- Ten columns per sector, centred at ±360 mm with unchanged 80 mm pitch; retain fifteen axial rows.
- Retain end-board positions and sixteen H-rings.
- **7392 slots / 3,784,704-channel capacity**.
- Maximum board-corner offset174.939824 mm.
- N2 pipe centre at sampling-back+197 mm: **12.060176 mm** radial separation from the maximum board corner and **3 mm** to the bath outer boundary.

The old twelve-column arrangement overlaps adjacent sectors at the compact radius. Two ten-column banks provide only2,523,136-channel capacity and cannot retain the3M planning allowance.

**Conservative endcap/services choice**

Retain the current endcap radii and internal geometry, translating the complete package **200 mm outward**:

| Boundary | Proposed |z| |
|---|---:|
| Endcap warm front | 5100 mm |
| Cold front / back | 5200 / 5910 mm |
| Sampling front / back | 5210 / 5660 mm |
| Warm back | 6060 mm |
| HCAL endcap front / back | 6560 / 8055.9 mm |

This retains a1000 mm front service reservation and500 mm rear break. Extend the HCAL barrel half-length to6060 mm if retaining its wrapping topology; keep its3130 mm front apothem and1495.9 mm depth.

The external bus can remain at3029 mm, but the compact N2 origin becomes2300.649779 mm. Its728.350221 mm offset **fails the old80 mm-jacket320 mm-radius construction**. Explicitly select an actual400 mm bend radius for both80/100 mm jackets, respecting the existing≥4OD minimum. Existing envelope arithmetic then needs896.784983/916.784983 mm, fitting1000 mm. Ports, headers, flanges and full bundle routes remain unqualified.

**Remaining gates**

- Native containment/overlap, exact channels, material/X₀ and transport checks.
- Vessel buckling/load/support, vacuum, contraction and thermal qualification; retained wall equivalents do not establish these.
- Fully populated barrel slots at40/60 mW require151.388/227.082 kW, exceeding the120 kW reference before static heat.
- Compact barrel full-depth bound becomes |η|1.378586; shifted endcap full-depth begins1.456386. The partial-depth interval changes and must remain in control plots.
- HCAL/forward interfaces and installed magnetic solution remain separate integration work.

Sources: DES026 lines63–73,98–103,145–160; DES032 cryostat/services sections; DES033 lines45–70; `barrel_services.py` lines34–68; pinned `services.json` and side/rear-routing proposal.
